advantages: Ensures an input is a filled array where every element is a `Stream`.
Provides a simple `true`/`false` guard for validating stream collections before processing.
Fails fast: returns `false` as soon as a non-`Stream` element is found.
Helps prevent runtime errors when code assumes all items are `Stream` instances.

parameterDescriptions.array: The array to be checked for Stream objects.

shortDescription: `areStreams` determines whether a value is a filled array in which every element is a `Stream`.
typeScriptHint: Use `areStreams` to validate unknown input before treating it as `Stream[]`; it returns `true` only when the value is a non-empty array and every element is a `Stream`.
useCase: Validate user-provided or dynamically built collections (e.g., multiple file read streams) before piping, resuming, or otherwise operating on them as a group.
